Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Role Summary

The Analyst, FP&A is a core member of the FP&A team supporting the organization, The role owns the monthly reporting rhythm: loading and validating KPI data, managing the month-end process in Vena, and preparing the financial review deck for leadership. Alongside this, the analyst supports budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis and ad hoc analysis, and helps document FP&A processes so they are repeatable and transferable.

Key Responsibilities

Monthly KPI Uploads Collect, validate and upload monthly KPI and operational data to the reporting/planning platform per the close calendar.

Maintain KPI definitions, data sources and upload checklists to ensure accuracy and consistency month to month.

Conduct trend analysis on the KPI drivers loaded each month, and flag anomalies and notable movements to FP&A leaders.

Vena Month-End Process Management

Manage month-end activities in Vena: actuals loads, mapping and validation checks, templates, workflow/task tracking and sign-offs.

Monitor the close timeline, follow up with contributors, and escalate open items so deliverables land on schedule.

Troubleshoot data, mapping and template issues; partner with system administrators on enhancements and fixes.

Monthly Financial Review Deck (Supporting Role)

Prepare the first draft of the monthly financial review deck: actuals vs. budget, forecast and prior year, with KPI trends and key drivers.

Hand off the draft to the team, who add commentary and finalize it for business reviews; incorporate feedback and updates.

Turn analysis into clean, executive-ready charts and tables; manage version control and meet draft deadlines.

Planning, Forecasting & Analysis (Supporting Role)

Support the FP&A team during budget, forecast and long-range planning cycles by preparing inputs, updating models and consolidating data.

Assist with variance, trend and driver-based analysis versus plan, forecast and prior periods.

Support scenario analysis, business cases and ROI analysis as directed by senior team members.

Assist in analyzing KPIs and underlying business drivers to help surface insights.

Help document assumptions, inputs and forecast drivers to support consistency and transparency.

Work with Accounting and cross-functional teams to help ensure financial data integrity.

Support ad hoc analysis and reports as needed; perform related duties as assigned.

Process Documentation & Continuous Improvement

Assist in documenting FP&A processes (month-end steps, KPI upload procedures, deck production, Vena workflows) as step-by-step guides and checklists.

Keep documentation current as processes and systems change; support cross-training and handoffs.

Identify opportunities to automate or streamline recurring reporting and flag them to the team.

Technical Skills

Required: advanced Microsoft Excel (financial modeling, pivot tables, lookups, SUMIFS, data validation); Microsoft PowerPoint for executive reporting.

Preferred: fundamental accounting and FP&A knowledge.

Good to have: working with AI tools to improve processes and assist in analyses.

Core Competencies

· Strong attention to detail and a high standard of accuracy.

· Excellent analytical, organizational and time-management skills; reliably meets month-end deadlines.

· Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining numbers to non-finance audiences.

· Discretion with confidential information.

· Curious, proactive and comfortable working with partners across time zones.

.
Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, business administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience required.

2+ years of experience in budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, financial modeling, management reporting, or a related field required.

Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Chartered Accountant (CA), Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA), Certified Management Accountant (CMA), or equivalent certification preferred.

Excellent oral and written communication skills.
Working knowledge of general accounting principles.
Strong attention to detail, with a high standard for accuracy.
Excellent organizational and analytical skills.
Proven ability to meet deadlines and manage priorities effectively.
Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel.

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Senior Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis Manager to join our Corporate Treasury Finance (CTF) & Balance Sheet Reporting & Analytics (BSRA) team within Finance. This role is located in Pune, India.

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:

• Functional leadership: Lead Corporate Treasury Finance (CTF) and Balance Sheet Reporting & Analytics (BSRA) from India, with full accountability for the quality, timeliness, control and continuous improvement of all deliverables.
• Plan & forecast: Own the end-to-end Balance Sheet and Net Interest Income (NII) plan and forecast process (plan rounds, rest-of-year and multi-year outlooks) for supported Lines of Business, ensuring a consistent methodology and timely submission into planning systems.
• Deposit forecast governance: Lead the deposit forecast and challenger process with Treasury Finance, GLS and LOB CFOs – framing assumptions, sensitivities, beta/pricing expectations and decision asks.
• NII & balance sheet narrative: Own the NII and balance sheet story for senior management, explaining drivers of variance versus plan, forecast and prior periods (rate, volume and mix) along with forward-looking risks and opportunities.
• Subject-matter expertise: Provide leadership on Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP), liquidity metrics (LCR and liquidity stress testing), interest-bearing and non-interest-bearing balance dynamics, and assess the impact of central bank rate changes, client flows and product/currency mix on deposits and NII.
• Reporting & analytics: Oversee daily, weekly, month-end and quarterly reporting – including month-to-date NII estimates, earnings support, management memos and client-, LOB- and firm-level analytics such as deposit pricing cohorts, client movers and beta analysis.
• Stakeholder partnership: Serve as trusted advisor and senior point of contact for Corporate Treasury, CIO, Treasury Finance, LOB CFOs, GLS, Interest Rate Risk, International Treasury, Controllers and Technology; represent India in senior forums and build durable partnerships through clear service models, SLAs and governance cadences.
• Scope expansion: Identify and lead the transition of new LOBs, platforms and processes into the India hub, partnering with Finance Data Strategy, Technology and other Centers of Excellence on firm-wide initiatives.
• Transformation & AI: Drive process simplification, report rationalization and adoption of Power BI, self-serve dashboards, automation and AI agents, tracking measurable efficiency gains aligned to Finance objectives.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

• Education: Master’s degree in a financial discipline such as accounting, finance, economics or statistics, or local country equivalent, is required; MBA preferred. Professional qualifications such as CA, CFA, FRM or CPA are a strong advantage.
• Experience: 15+ years of progressive experience in finance, FP&A, treasury finance or balance sheet management within banking or financial services.
• Domain expertise: Strong knowledge of Asset and Liability Management (ALM), deposits, NII, FTP, liquidity (LCR/LST), interest rate risk and the bank balance sheet, with a sound understanding of financial controls and governance.
• Global operating model: Proven track record of building and scaling India-based Centers of Excellence that partner with US/EMEA senior leadership; ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate complex technical-financial topics into clear business narratives.
• Communication & tools: Excellent written, verbal and executive presentation skills; advanced MS Office; proficiency with enterprise planning, reporting and ERP tools (e.g., Planning Analytics/TM1, Cognos, HFM, Oracle) and Power BI – exposure to Python/SQL, automation and AI tools is a plus.
• People leadership: 7+ years leading multi-layered teams (VPs, AVPs, Specialists and Analysts), with demonstrated strength in organization design, workforce and succession planning, coaching and performance management, and in building an inclusive, high-performance culture.
